and coalesce(tmp.ta_amount,0) = 0 and coalesce(tmp.overdue_earnings,0) = 0 and t.id = tmp.id ) ) update eg_contract ec set report_flag = 1 where exists(

INSERT INTO financialdb."CT_BD_ASSISTANTGH" ("VC_NIANYR", "ID", "ACCOUNTNUM", "ACCOUNTNAME", "COMPANY", "CURRENCYSTD", "ACCOUNTTYPE", "ACCOUNTDETAILNUM", "ACCOUNTDETAIL", "CURRENCY", "FILTERDATE", "MONDEBITSTAMONEY", "MONDEBITORIMONEY", "MONCREDITSTAMONEY", "MONCREDITORIMONEY", "STABALANCE", "ORIBALANCE", "DC", "MONDEBITRMBMONEY", "MONCREDITRMBMONEY", "RMBBALANCE", "CREATETIME")
select #{queryDate}, max(EAAB.ID), EAAB.account_code ,eaab.account_name,eoc.org_name , eaab.currency_code , --取金蝶账套的本位币币种 '合同', --核算项目类型 eaab.contract_code , --核算项目明细编码 ec.contract_name, --核算项目明细 eaab.currency_code , --原币币别 #{queryDate}, --过滤日期 sum(coalesce(ev_eve.debit_amount,0)*eeer.exchange_rate ),--截止查询日本月累计借方发生额本位币，取汇率，* （原币至本位币的汇率） sum(coalesce(ev_eve.debit_amount,0)),--截止查询日本月累计借方发生额原币 sum(coalesce(ev_eve.credit_amount,0)*eeer.exchange_rate),--截止查询日本月累计贷方发生额本位币，取汇率，* （原币至本位币的汇率） sum(coalesce(ev_eve.credit_amount,0)), --截止查询日本月累计贷方发生额原币 case when eaa.account_category='1' then sum((coalesce(eaab.month_end_credit_balance,0)+coalesce(ev_eve.credit_amount,0))*eeer.exchange_rate) else sum((coalesce(eaab.month_end_debit_balance,0)+coalesce(ev_eve.debit_amount,0))*eeer.exchange_rate) --（原币至本位币的汇率） end, --截止查询日余额本位币 case when eaa.account_category='1' then sum(coalesce(eaab.month_end_credit_balance,0)+coalesce(ev_eve.credit_amount,0)) else sum(coalesce(eaab.month_end_debit_balance,0)+coalesce(ev_eve.debit_amount,0)) end, --截止查询日余额原币 case when eaa.account_category='1' then '贷' else '借' end, --截止查询日余额方向， sum(coalesce(ev_eve.debit_amount,0)*eeer.exchange_rate),--截止查询日本月累计借方发生额RMB，取汇率，* （原币到人民币的汇率） sum(coalesce(ev_eve.credit_amount,0)*eeer.exchange_rate),--截止查询日本月累计贷方发生额RMB ，取汇率，* （原币到人民币的汇率） case when eaa.account_category='1' then sum((coalesce(eaab.month_end_credit_balance,0)+coalesce(ev_eve.credit_amount,0))*eeer.exchange_rate) --（原币到人民币的汇率） else sum((coalesce(eaab.month_end_debit_balance,0)+coalesce(ev_eve.debit_amount,0))*eeer.exchange_rate) --（原币到人民币的汇率） end, --截止查询日余额人民币 #{queryDate}--截止查询日余额RMB from eg_account_assist_balance eaab left join ( select ev.org_id, eve.contract_code, eve.account_code, ev.currency, sum(eve.debit_amount) debit_amount, sum(eve.credit_amount) credit_amount from eg_voucher ev join eg_voucher_entry eve on ev.id = eve.voucher_id and ev.period_code = to_char(to_date(#{queryDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYYMM')::Integer and eve.period_code = to_char(to_date(#{queryDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYYMM')::Integer and ev.voucher_status = '3' group by ev.org_id, eve.contract_code, eve.account_code, eve.account_name, ev.currency )ev_eve on eaab.org_id = ev_eve.org_id and eaab.contract_code = ev_eve.contract_code and eaab.account_code = ev_eve.account_code and eaab.currency_code = ev_eve.currency join eg_currency curr on eaab.currency_code = curr.currency_code join eg_eas_exchange_rate eeer on eeer.source_eas_code = curr.eas_code and eeer.execute_date = #{queryDate} and eeer.target_eas_code = 'BB01' join eg_org_company eoc on eaab.org_id=eoc.org_id join eg_contract ec on eaab.contract_code =ec.contract_code join (select distinct ea.account_code ,ea.account_category from eg_account ea) eaa on eaa.account_code=eaab.account_code where 1=1 --and eaab.org_id=eoc.org_id --and eaab.contract_code =ec.contract_code --and eaa.account_code=eaab.account_code and eaab.period_code = to_char(to_date(#{queryDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - interval '1 month', 'yyyyMM')::integer ---TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE,'YYYYMM') and eaab.account_code in ('1231.04.02', '1231.03.04', '1231.04.01', '1231.03.01', '1532.02', '1532.01', '1122.06', '1122.07', '1221.04', '1221.07', '1122.03', '1122.03.01', '1122.03.02', '1122.03.03', '1122.03.04', '1531.01.01', '1531.01.02', '1531.01.03', '1531.01.04', '1531.01.05', '1531.01.06', '1531.01.08', '1531.01.09', '1531.01.10', '2701.01', '2701.02', '2701.07' ) group by EAAB.account_code ,eaab.account_name,eoc.org_name , eaab.currency_code ,eaab.contract_code,ec.contract_name,eaa.account_category
